source.title: Postponement of WCA World Championship 2021 (December 2020)
source.content:
Because of the ongoing global COVID-19 pandemic, the WCA Board and the core organization team have decided to postpone the WCA World Championship to December 28-31, 2021. 

We believe that the chances of carrying out the World Championship in July are decreasing. There is a good chance that in July at least some global restrictions caused by the pandemic will still be in force. A Championship in December 2021 means a postponement of 5 months. These months could be very crucial as far as the pandemic is concerned, and would make it much more likely that we can have a Championship in its own right. 
<!-- break -->
As a reminder, Championship dates are not officially confirmed until the competition website has been created and announced on the WCA website and is shown on the Competitions page. You can read the announcement from the organization team [here](https://www.wcaworlds2021.com/news/postponement/).

Thanks for your understanding. We hope to see you in 2021 in Almere. Stay safe!

translation.title: 2021 WCA 世锦赛延期通知（2020 年 12 月）
translation.content:
由于全球新冠疫情仍在持续，WCA 董事会与核心主办团队决定，将 WCA 世锦赛推迟至 2021 年 12 月 28–31 日。

我们认为，7 月如期举办世锦赛的可能性正在降低。届时，全球很可能仍有部分防疫限制尚未解除。改到 2021 年 12 月意味着延期 5 个月，这几个月对疫情发展可能至关重要，也能大幅提高我们完整举办一届世锦赛的可能性。

提醒大家，锦标赛日期只有在比赛网站建立、比赛在 WCA 官网公布并显示于比赛列表后，才算正式确认。主办团队的公告可在[这里](https://www.wcaworlds2021.com/news/postponement/)阅读。

感谢理解。希望 2021 年在阿尔梅勒与大家相见，请保重！
